name: MOSS-Image SFT ComfyUI — simplified launch candidate
readme:
# MOSS ComfyUI — candidate

This configuration is under validation and is not the published image.

The intended flow is Deploy, then Connect to MOSS ComfyUI, then choose a workflow. No separate MOSS password or model-download token is required. First startup prepares the models and shows progress.

Use a CUDA 13.0-compatible NVIDIA GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM. A 60 GB container disk allows first use without a storage edit. To keep models and images after stopping, select persistent storage mounted at /workspace in Runpod Storage.

Native connection settings are in the companion console metadata. Do not publish until its candidate image and native Connect flow are verified.
